name: hero-kapadokya
usedIn: Ana sayfa hero videosu (tam genişlik, metin sol altta; mobilde 4:5 ortadan kırpılır)

decisions.yapı: 5 plan × 3 sn = 15 sn montaj, döngüye uygun

style: Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Vision3 250D, fine natural grain, soft halation, warm earthy palette of ochre, rust and dry gold, low golden-hour autumn sun, gentle natural camera motion, 24fps, cinematic, calm. No people, no text, no logos, no hot air balloons, no vehicles, no modern buildings.

shots.prompt: Wide establishing shot of the Cappadocia valley at golden hour: fairy chimneys and soft tuff ridges, long shadows across dry autumn steppe, slow dolly forward.
A herd of wild horses gallops across a dry golden grass plain beneath tuff cliffs, backlit dust hanging in the low sun, smooth side tracking shot.
Close-up of dry golden grass and thistles swaying in the wind, strong backlight, shallow depth of field, slow handheld drift.
Weathered carved stone doorway of an old cave dwelling, warm sunlight raking across the rough tuff wall, dust motes in the air, slow push in.
Static wide shot as the sun sinks behind the Rose Valley ridge, pink and amber sky, calm and still, the lower left of the frame falls into soft shadow.
